annotations.title: Liquidation price of a leveraged position

description: Use this when someone asks at what price their own leveraged long or short would be liquidated. The price at which a leveraged long or short would be liquidated, from entry price and leverage, with isolated margin. Name a coin to use its live price as the entry and to get its funding rate and the heaviest levels on that coin's liquidation map beside the answer, so the position can be judged against where the crowd would be closed. Answers "where is my liquidation price on a 20x long from 60,000" and "how far is liquidation on a 10x ETH short opened now".

coin.description: Ticker of one of the sixty followed coins, e.g. BTC

entry.description: Entry price in dollars. Leave out to use the coin's live price

maintenance_margin_pct.description: Maintenance margin in percent; 0.4 when left out
